name: 39560 · Long Beach, MS
findings: ZIP 39560 (Long Beach) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39560 (Long Beach) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
